from pathlib import Path
from docx import Document
import re
stem='GMRI_Global_Human_Life_180_Day_Threat_and_Preservation_Assessment_v11_2026-11-04'
mp=Path('/mnt/data')/(stem+'.md')
dp=Path('/mnt/data')/(stem+'.docx')
old='publicly released information dated on or before 3 November 2026. No subsequent outcomes are used to manufacture foresight. Geographic labels refer to populations exposed, not claims about every resident of a nation or state.'
new='publicly released information dated through 4 November 2026. Analyst forecasts were formulated on 4 November within the previously agreed 180-day interval and must not claim foresight for 3 November or other already-observed outcomes. Geographic labels refer to specifically exposed populations, not every resident of a nation or state.'
s=mp.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert s.count(old)==1, ('markdown occurrences',s.count(old))
mp.write_text(s.replace(old,new),encoding='utf-8')
d=Document(dp)
num=0
for p in d.paragraphs:
 for r in p.runs:
  if old in r.text:
   r.text=r.text.replace(old,new)
   num+=1
assert num==1, ('docx replacement',num)
d.save(dp)
# Evidence register and all cited sources cross-check
ids=set(re.findall(r'\[S(\d\d)\]', s))
registered=set(re.findall(r'\*\*\[S(\d\d)\]\*\*',s))
missing=ids-registered
assert not missing, ('Missing evidence register entries:',sorted(missing))
assert all(len(re.findall(r'\| A%02d \|' % i,s))==1 for i in range(1,10))
assert all(len(re.findall(r'\| B%02d \|' % i,s))==1 for i in range(1,7))
assert all(len(re.findall(r'\| C%02d \|' % i,s))==1 for i in range(1,7))
assert '1996-2005' in s and '1996-2025' in s
assert 49600+34500+48800+64200+137500==334600
print({'source_ids_used':len(ids), 'source_ids_registered':len(registered), 'replaced':num, 'A':9, 'B':6, 'C':6})
